posts.description: The Booker Prize judges have lost their minds. The picked the worst of the five shortlisted books “The End of Everything” which I actually hated.

posts.title: The Living Realm (Jordan Tannahill 2026)
posts.description: Finished reading: The Living Realm by Jordan Tannahill 📚 Truly astonishing. So many memorable moments and elements captured in exquisite but earthy language. A masterpiece. You can order it from independent stores in NZ via Bookhub

posts.title: Lifted (Mandy Hager, 2026)
posts.description: In the context of the wonderful “ Bird Land ” exhibition at the Christchurch Art Gallery (on till 8 February 2027), I’ve just started reading Mandy Hager’s “ Lifted ”, apparently inspired by Bill Hammond’s incredible painting “The Fall of Icarus”. You can get Lifted at Unity Books: www.unitybooks.co.nz/products/… or at BookHub: bookhub.co.nz/p/lifted-…
